blocks.text: This unit covered model building and data visualization: the role of statistical models in solving real-world problems, building basic models such as linear regression and evaluating them, experimental design, the types and uses of visualizations, descriptive statistics, and tools such as MS Excel, Google Sheets, Python (Matplotlib) and Tableau. The summary also mentions hypothesis testing, randomization and heatmaps, which the chapter names but does not teach in detail.
